payload.claim: `Criterion.mutant`'s docstring says the field is "`None` on every parsed spec", but `parse_spec` itself never clears or rejects an inline mutant; only `discover_specs`'s non-retired path, `run_task`, and `follow_up._validate` enforce that externally. A `retired=True` scan, or any direct call to `intake.parse_spec` on text with an inline mutant, returns a `Criterion` whose `mutant` is not `None`, so the docstring overstates what parsing alone guarantees.
